headline: Bitmine Incurs $6.3 Billion Loss on Ethereum Position Amid Market Slump
summary: Tom Lee's Bitmine revealed a $6.3 billion loss on its Ethereum investment portfolio after averaging down on ETH holdings over the past year amid falling valuations.
why: Corporate crypto treasury holdings have gained prominence, exposing balance sheets directly to severe digital asset volatility.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Severe institutional mark-to-market losses highlight continued balance sheet de-risking in major crypto tokens.
